To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) The curvature of the wavefront is important to perceive distance of a virtual sound source in Wave Field Synthesized sound fields; (2) The curvature of wavefronts of virtual sources can be manipulated by changing the position of the loudspeakers in the array; and (3) The perceived distance of virtual sound sources can be changed by manipulating the curvature of wavefront of the virtual sound sources.
